items.heading: There Is No Single Correct
items.text: There is no single correct exam for every applicant. The two tests were built for different degree types, and the honest starting point is checking what your actual target programs read, not picking based on which exam sounds more familiar or which one a senior at your college took.

items.heading: Before the Program
items.text: Before the program-by-program breakdown, here is what actually differs between the two exams as they stand today.

items.heading: This Is the Part That
items.text: This is the part that should decide most of the choice, and it is also the part most comparison guides skim past. Read your target program's current admissions page directly, not a summary written a year or two ago.
